newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom awards big cable orders.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom awards big cable orders.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG said on Wednesday it had awarded contracts totalling 240 million marks ($157.3 million) for copper and fibre optic cable.
From a list of 14 international companies, Telekom awarded the contracts to Alcatel Alsthom of France, Lucent Technologies, Siemens, Nokia, as well as a group of German mid-sized companies.
The orders were for a total of four million kilometres of copper cable and 400,000 kilometres of fibre optic cable. It would cover the company's cable requirements for 1997.
Telekom gave no details about the breakdown of the award.
